The '''Battle of Palanhi''' was a battle of the [[Jedi Civil War]], a conflict between the [[Galactic Republic/Legends|Galactic Republic]] and [[Darth/Legends|Darth]] [[Revan/Legends|Revan's]] [[Darth Revan's Sith Empire|Sith Empire]]. The Sith Empire advanced on [[Palanhi/Legends|Palanhi]], as part of a campaign from [[Iridonia/Legends|Iridonia]]. At Palanhi, the two sides fought with the Republic emerging as the victors.<ref name="EA" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Battle of Palanhi makes its only appearance in ''[[The Essential Atlas]]''.<ref name="EA" /> An exact date is not provided for the battle, and it only illustrates the battle on the galactic map rather than in prose.<ref name="EA" />
